title: upgrade-dryrun-sentinel-suite-and-rollback-scorer
creator: Liam Chen
description: Build and integrate an automated 'dry‑run sentinel' preflight suite that performs a realistic upgrade dry-run across target LTS and non-LTS channels. The suite will: 1) run smoke requests with representative chat + streaming flows, 2) exercise KV cache warmup + checkpointing during a simulated model switch, 3) execute a lightweight perf fingerprint (p95 token latency, tokens/sec, memory allocation) and compare against a historical baseline, and 4) score rollback risk using a heuristic scorer that aggregates functional failures, perf regressions, and stability signals. The goal is to detect failures earlier in CI/CD and reduce noisy canaries by surfacing an actionable rollback score and triage hints for oncall.
acceptance_criteria: Dry‑run sentinel runs as a pipeline step and returns a JSON report with pass/fail + rollback_score
Baseline comparison uses last stable release from the targeted channel and highlights regressions >5% on key perf metrics
Smoke tests cover chat streaming, embeddings generation, and KV cache resume within 90s median runtime
Heuristic rollback scorer documented and produces reproducible scores for synthetic failures
Report artifacts are uploaded to the preflight dashboard and linked in the pipeline run
implementation_notes: We will implement sentinel as a light runner in the existing validation-orchestrator service to reuse scheduling and artifact storage
Use synthetic workload harness from ENG-31207 for request generation; add new templates for long-context streaming
Perf fingerprint will capture p50/p95 latency, tokens_per_sec, GPU memory high-water mark, and kv_cache_hit_rate
Rollback scorer is a weighted sum: functional_failures*0.6 + perf_regressions*0.3 + stability_signals*0.1; weights subject to tuning
To avoid flakiness, use three sequential runs and median the numeric metrics; fail only if median breaches thresholds
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Synthetic workloads may not match customer traffic and produce false positives. Mitigation: add channel-specific templates and allow teams to opt-in with recorded production prompt sets.
Risk: Adding the sentinel step increases CI time. Mitigation: make sentinel opt-in per release branch and provide a fast 'smoke-only' mode for quick validation
Risk: Rollback scorer tuning could mask regressions or create noise. Mitigation: log raw signals and expose weights in Console for later adjustment
